name: The Alphabet That Answers
description: A 1/1 moving image in which nine figures are each reconstructed in the dominant medium of their age, from Socrates in voice to Laozi in silence, dissolving one into the next and folding back on themselves.

attributes.value: Socrates, Jesus, Paul, Luther, Ada Lovelace, Alan Turing, Marshall McLuhan, post-alphabetist self-portrait, Laozi
Media history, writing, AI, the human signal
